title: Real-video replay evaluation of prior-initialised MPM twins on Spring-Gaus real captures
written_utc: 2026-11-16 06:30 UTC (before any v3v metric was computed)

data.source: data/external_datasets/springgaus_gdrive/real_capture.zip (untrusted; only PNG/JPG/JSON decoded, nothing executed, python -I)
data.frames: the 20 released synchronized frames per camera (0..19), released masks; hit frame 6-7
data.calibration: released cameras_calib.json (shared K/dist, per-camera rvec/tvec, checkerboard world frame, metres, up = -z)

twin_construction.shared_by_all_arms: frame-0 3-view visual hull (2.5 mm voxels -> MPM particles), ground height = lowest 3-view hull point at the hit frame, pre-impact velocity = parabola fit (|g| = 9.8) of triangulated centroids of frames 0..hit-1. Same as scripts/v3f/springgaus_replay.py. This initial state uses all 3 cameras at frames <= hit (stated caveat for the held-out-camera split).
twin_construction.engine: DeformFieldBench mpm_solver_warp, jelly (fixed corotated), rho = 1000 (only E/rho matters), slip ground friction 0.3, rpic_damping 0, grid_v_damping 0.99999, CFL dt; simulated for the 20 released frames only
twin_construction.free_parameter: log10(E/rho x 1000); nu fixed (prior arms: predicted nu; constant arms: jelly train-class mean nu 0.278). Pre-impact velocity scale NOT refined (velocity already fitted from frames 0..hit-1).
twin_construction.appearance: each particle coloured at t0 from the training cameras of the fold only: z-buffer visibility test per camera, colour sampled from the visible camera closest to the particle; particles visible in no training camera take the colour of the nearest coloured particle. Colours are carried with the particles (Lagrangian).

folds: 3 folds; in fold h camera h is held out; the other 2 cameras are the training cameras. Fit set = training cameras x frames 0..9 (first half). Every arm is evaluated in every fold and metrics are averaged over the 3 folds per object.

arms.prior_refine: compass search on log10 E/rho starting at the prior: step 0.5 decade, try +/-step, move on improvement, halve on failure, stop at step < 0.0625 or 12 simulations (prior evaluation counts as 1). Objective = 1 - mean mask IoU on the fit set only.
arms.class_mean: uninformed: mean log10 E/rho x 1000 of the jelly class in the V2 train split (3.482), nu 0.278
arms.global_constant_loo: grid log10 E/rho x 1000 in {3.00, 3.25, ..., 6.00} (13 sims/object, nu 0.278); for object o pick the grid value maximising the mean fit-set IoU of the OTHER 4 objects (same fold), evaluate on o
arms.oracle: upper bound of our engine: the simulated E (grid or compass points) with the best IoU on ALL frames x ALL cameras of that object (peeks at the evaluation data)

nonphysical_references.rigid_track_2cam: held-out camera split only: frame-0 hull moved rigidly so that its centroid follows the centroid trajectory triangulated from the 2 training cameras at every frame (uses observations at the evaluated frames; no physics)
nonphysical_references.persist_last: future split only: last fit frame (frame 9) frozen: the observed frame-9 masks/images are used as the prediction for frames 10..19 in every camera; for 3D metrics the frame-9 3-view hull is frozen

evaluation_splits.heldout_camera: camera h, frames 1..19 (frame 0 is the hull input), averaged over the 3 folds
evaluation_splits.future_frames: frames 10..19, all 3 cameras, averaged over the 3 folds (twin of fold h)

metrics.mask_iou: simulated particles projected with the released calibration (incl. distortion), splatted as discs with radius = round(0.75 x projected voxel spacing) (>= 1 px), then morphological close with an elliptical kernel of 2 x spacing + 1 px; IoU against the released mask
metrics.psnr_ssim: rendered image = z-buffered disc splats of the particle colours (holes inside the closed silhouette inpainted), black outside the simulated silhouette; observed image multiplied by its mask (black background); PSNR over the pixels of the union mask (8-bit, MAX=255) and SSIM (Gaussian 11x11, sigma 1.5, on RGB, averaged over channels) averaged over the union mask, computed in the union bbox crop
metrics.lpips: not computed (lpips package/weights not installed on the server; not cheap within the time box)
metrics.centroid_err_cm: sim silhouettes -> per-camera mask centroids -> same DLT triangulation as the observations (apples-to-apples); error to the observed triangulated mask centroid, 3D Euclidean, cm
metrics.lowest_point_err_cm: |min up of simulated particles - min up of the observed per-frame 3-view visual hull|, cm
metrics.chamfer_cm: symmetric mean nearest-neighbour distance (cm) between simulated particles and the observed per-frame 3-view visual hull (a 3D PROXY, not true 3D; it uses all 3 cameras, so it is reported for the future split only)
metrics.upper_bound_reference: IoU of the frame-0 hull projection vs. frame-0 masks (geometry/splatting ceiling)

statistics: per-object values (fold-averaged), mean over the 5 objects, 95% percentile bootstrap CI over objects (10000 resamples, n = 5) for each arm and for paired differences vs. prior, plus leave-one-object-out range of the mean. n = 5 is stated everywhere; no significance claims beyond the CI.
reporting_rules: all arms reported, including ones where the twin is worse than a trivial/non-physical reference; protocol not changed after seeing metrics (any deviation logged in RESULTS.json 'deviations')
